children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Turn a game image into a validated, installable bundle with metadata, a GameTemplate, documentation, and reproducible OCI content.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: The source directory is editable; the versioned OCI artifact is the immutable distribution unit.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Create a stable, DNS-safe module identity and the source files required for humans, validation, and distribution.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Create module.yaml, template.yaml, and README.md, plus optional locales/ translations (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Add a sample GameServer when it improves acceptance testing.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Declare display name, game, summary, version, and minimum Gameplane.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Start with one tested version and only capabilities the game actually supports.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Declare image, ports, resources, storage, config inputs, and defaults.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Keep runtime paths under /data aligned with agent behavior.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Add versions and capabilities only after complete lifecycle tests.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Validate (checks translations, v0.4.0), push to the local registry, wait for source synchronization, install, and prove Module and generated template readiness.

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
